title: Gradient Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition
summary: Yann Le Cun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio and Patrick Haffner published 'Gradient Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition' in Proceedings of the IEEE in 1998. The paper documents gradient-based learning for handwritten character and document recognition, including convolutional neural networks and the LeNet-5 architecture.
significance: A documented 1998 research-publication milestone for convolutional neural networks and trainable document-recognition systems, recorded at publication-year precision without treating it as an invention date, development start, universal priority claim, or causal ancestor assertion.

verification.note: Coauthor Léon Bottou's publication page directly supports the title, four authors, Proceedings of IEEE venue, volume 86 issue 11, pages 2278-2324, and publication year 1998, and provides the paper itself. CiNii Research independently corroborates the title, authors, DOI 10.1109/5.726791, publisher, venue, volume/issue, pages and year. The candidate deliberately stores only year precision because this run did not establish a publication day from first-party evidence. No invention date, development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edge is inferred.
